verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe an autonomous deep review that starts from an open-ended research goal. It plans its own searches, follows citations and key authors, and keeps going until new searches stop finding relevant papers, then outputs a ranked list with a written synthesis. Community reports back this up indirectly: clarifying follow-up questions, multi-minute searches and an exhaustiveness metric, which points to more than a single-pass summary. Missing for 10: independent evidence showing the internal search-planning and citation-following steps directly, and consistent depth on niche queries (one user saw near-identical results after refining a search).

support.subject: As a researcher, I can pose a research question and get an autonomous multi-step investigation, not just a single-pass summary

citations.quote: Runs a deep literature review from an open-ended research goal and produces a ranked list of papers with a written synthesis.
Plans its own searches, follows citations and key authors, and stops only when new searches stop finding relevant papers.
Undermind asks follow-up questions to understand exactly what you need.
